# Pipe table model and authored positions

```````````````````````````````` example
| Left | Center | Right | None |
| :--- | :----: | ----: | ---- |
| a | *b* | `c` | d |
.
Document scope=1:1..3:21 children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..3:21 columns=[left:null,center:null,right:null,none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:32 children=4
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:2..1:7 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:6 literal="Left" children=0
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:9..1:16 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:10..1:15 literal="Center" children=0
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:18..1:24 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:19..1:23 literal="Right" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:26..1:31 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:27..1:30 literal="None" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:21 children=4
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:4 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 literal="a" children=0
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:6..3:10 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Emphasis scope=3:7..3:9 children=1
    │       │       └── Text scope=3:8..3:8 literal="b" children=0
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:12..3:16 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Code scope=3:13..3:15 literal="c" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=3:18..3:20 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=3:19..3:19 literal="d" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
a | b
--|--
c | d
.
Document scope=1:1..3:5 children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..3:5 columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:5 children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:1..1:2 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:1..1:1 literal="a" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:4..1:5 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:5..1:5 literal="b" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:5 children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:1..3:2 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=3:1..3:1 literal="c" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=3:4..3:5 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=3:5..3:5 literal="d" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example

line
a | b
-|-
c | d
.

├── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:4 children=3
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 literal="para" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=1:5..1:5 children=0
│   └── Text scope=2:1..2:4 literal="line" children=0
└── Table scope=3:1..5:5 columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:5 children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:1..3:2 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=3:1..3:1 literal="a" children=0

    │           └── Text scope=3:5..3:5 literal="b" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=5:1..5:5 children=2
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
| a | b |
| - | - |
no pipes
| short |
| x | y | extra |

| z |
.
Document scope=1:1..7:5 children=2
├── Table scope=1:1..5:17 columns=[none:null,none:null] children=4
│   ├── TableHead children=1
│   │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:9 children=2
│   │       ├── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │       │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 literal="a" children=0
│   │       └── TableCell scope=1:6..1:8 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=1:7..1:7 literal="b" children=0
│   ├── TableBody children=3
│   │   ├── TableRow scope=3:1..3:8 children=2
│   │   │   ├── TableCell scope=3:1..3:8 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │   │   │   └── Text scope=3:1..3:8 literal="no pipes" children=0
│   │   │   └── TableCell scope=3:8..3:8 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
│   │   ├── TableRow scope=4:1..4:9 children=2
│   │   │   ├── TableCell scope=4:2..4:8 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │   │   │   └── Text scope=4:3..4:7 literal="short" children=0
│   │   │   └── TableCell scope=4:9..4:9 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
│   │   └── TableRow scope=5:1..5:17 children=2
│   │       ├── TableCell scope=5:2..5:4 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │       │   └── Text scope=5:3..5:3 literal="x" children=0
│   │       └── TableCell scope=5:6..5:8 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=5:7..5:7 literal="y" children=0
│   └── TableFoot children=0
└── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:5 children=1
    └── Text scope=7:1..7:5 literal="| z |" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example

| c |

│   │       └── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 literal="a" children=0
│   ├── TableBody children=1
│   │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:5 children=1
│   │       └── TableCell scope=3:2..3:4 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 literal="b" children=0
│   └── TableFoot children=0
├── Heading scope=4:1..4:3 level=1 children=1
│   └── Text scope=4:3..4:3 literal="h" children=0

    └── Text scope=5:1..5:5 literal="| c |" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
| \| *after* | `\|` |
| - | - |
| [\|](url) | *x\|y* |
.
Document scope=1:1..3:22 children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..3:22 columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:21 children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:2..1:13 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=2
    │       │   ├── Text scope=1:3..1:5 literal="| " children=0
    │       │   └── Emphasis scope=1:6..1:12 children=1
    │       │       └── Text scope=1:7..1:11 literal="after" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:15..1:20 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Code scope=1:16..1:19 literal="|" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:22 children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:12 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Link scope=3:3..3:11 dest=url("url") title=null children=1
    │       │       └── Text scope=3:4..3:5 literal="|" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=3:14..3:21 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Emphasis scope=3:15..3:20 children=1
    │               └── Text scope=3:16..3:19 literal="x|y" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
lead
another line
| x\|y | `z\|w` |

| \| | \|\| |

├── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:12 children=3
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 literal="lead" children=0

    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:17 children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:7 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=3:3..3:6 literal="x|y" children=0

    │           └── Code scope=3:10..3:15 literal="z|w" children=0

    │   └── TableRow scope=5:1..5:13 children=2
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> | 汉\|字 | 😀 |
> | - | - |
> | *汉\|字* | `😀\|` |

- | x\|y | z |
  | - | - |
  | \| | short |
.
Document scope=1:1..7:16 children=2
├── Callout scope=1:1..3:27 variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Table scope=1:3..3:27 columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
│       ├── TableHead children=1
│       │   └── TableRow scope=1:3..1:21 children=2
│       │       ├── TableCell scope=1:4..1:13 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│       │       │   └── Text scope=1:5..1:12 literal="汉|字" children=0
│       │       └── TableCell scope=1:15..1:20 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│       │           └── Text scope=1:16..1:19 literal="😀" children=0
│       ├── TableBody children=1
│       │   └── TableRow scope=3:3..3:27 children=2
│       │       ├── TableCell scope=3:4..3:15 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│       │       │   └── Emphasis scope=3:5..3:14 children=1
│       │       │       └── Text scope=3:6..3:13 literal="汉|字" children=0
│       │       └── TableCell scope=3:17..3:26 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│       │           └── Code scope=3:18..3:25 literal="😀|" children=0
│       └── TableFoot children=0
└── List scope=5:1..7:16 flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=5:1..7:16 marker=null children=1
        └── Table scope=5:3..7:16 columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
            ├── TableHead children=1
            │   └── TableRow scope=5:3..5:14 children=2
            │       ├── TableCell scope=5:4..5:9 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
            │       │   └── Text scope=5:5..5:8 literal="x|y" children=0
            │       └── TableCell scope=5:11..5:13 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
            │           └── Text scope=5:12..5:12 literal="z" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
| a |
| - |
| \| user@example.com tail@example.org |
| x\|&amp;user@example.com |
| \| https://example.com |
| **\|** ~~\|~~ :tag[\|] |
.
Document scope=1:1..6:26 children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..6:26 columns=[none:null] children=5
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:5 children=1
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 literal="a" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=4
    │   ├── TableRow scope=3:1..3:40 children=1
    │   │   └── TableCell scope=3:2..3:39 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=4
    │   │       ├── Text scope=3:3..3:5 literal="| " children=0
    │   │       ├── Link scope=3:6..3:21 dest=url("mailto:user@example.com") title=null children=1
    │   │       │   └── Text scope=3:6..3:21 literal="user@example.com" children=0
    │   │       ├── Text scope=3:22..3:22 literal=" " children=0
    │   │       └── Link scope=3:23..3:38 dest=url("mailto:tail@example.org") title=null children=1
    │   │           └── Text scope=3:23..3:38 literal="tail@example.org" children=0
    │   ├── TableRow scope=4:1..4:28 children=1
    │   │   └── TableCell scope=4:2..4:27 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=2
    │   │       ├── Text scope=4:3..4:10 literal="x|&" children=0
    │   │       └── Link scope=4:11..4:26 dest=url("mailto:user@example.com") title=null children=1
    │   │           └── Text scope=4:11..4:26 literal="user@example.com" children=0
    │   ├── TableRow scope=5:1..5:26 children=1
    │   │   └── TableCell scope=5:2..5:25 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=2
    │   │       ├── Text scope=5:3..5:5 literal="| " children=0
    │   │       └── Link scope=5:6..5:24 dest=url("https://example.com") title=null children=1
    │   │           └── Text scope=5:6..5:24 literal="https://example.com" children=0
    │   └── TableRow scope=6:1..6:26 children=1
    │       └── TableCell scope=6:2..6:25 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=5
    │           ├── Strong scope=6:3..6:8 children=1
    │           │   └── Text scope=6:5..6:6 literal="|" children=0
    │           ├── Text scope=6:9..6:9 literal=" " children=0
    │           ├── Strikethrough scope=6:10..6:15 children=1
    │           │   └── Text scope=6:12..6:13 literal="|" children=0
    │           ├── Text scope=6:16..6:16 literal=" " children=0
    │           └── Directive scope=6:17..6:24 name="tag" attributes=null children=0
    │               └── DirectiveLabel scope=6:21..6:24 children=1
    │                   └── Text scope=6:22..6:22 literal="|" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example

    │   └── TableRow scope=9:1..9:6 children=1
    │       └── TableCell scope=9:2..9:5 rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=9:3..9:4 literal="|" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````
